why: Both land on the same bank and financial automation hedgehog and both say to stop fighting Rival I across the whole computer market, but Analysis 1 covers accounting users, lists the narrow, accounting-machine-dependent product line as a brutal fact, and explicitly warns that the company could drift when the single strong leader departs with no successor ready. Analysis 2 has the tighter one-screen verdict, but it is weaker on the leader-dependence decline mechanism and misses the narrow-line fact.
